recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR source work is needed unless a later design change replaces or renames the Resource Type Index Security Category tab.
issue_request: FHIR-25939 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. The request was to add narrative on the security page explaining how to navigate to the Resource Types page and select the Security Category tab for resource-level Security Considerations categorization.
initial_application: Commit 563e56f35b35b9f94193094afca019ec08e2b63c, whose subject includes FHIR-25939, added a sentence to source/security.html pointing readers to resourcelist.html and the resourcelist.html#tabs-7 Security Category tab.
additional_context: The current source/security.html Security and Privacy Considerations section still contains the navigation text. The target source/resourcelist.html page defines the Security Category tab as #tabs-7 and renders <%res-list-security%>. Later security-page history retained the link while changing the label from common to dominant Security Category. Confluence refs found Security WG meeting pages mentioning FHIR-25939, and Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source already satisfies the Jira resolution. Adding another summary page or duplicate prose would not improve implementer understanding and would add maintenance drift.
